data.long_meaning: Kulsumah is an Arabic name derived from the Arabic word ‘kulsum’, which means ‘the full moon'. This name is often associated with beauty, prosperity, and spiritual completeness. The name Kulsumah carries the meaning “Moon's fullness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kulsumah usually hope their child will grow to embody moon's fullness and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name can serve as a reminder to seek inner fulfillment and to continue striving towards spiritual growth throughout one's life.
